sources.institution: State universities (IU, Purdue, Ball State, Indiana State, USI, Vincennes, Ivy Tech) and all local units
sources.system: Indiana Gateway for Government Units (DLGF / IU Indiana Business Research Center) - Form 100R Employee Compensation
sources.download_url: Report builder export (CSV/Excel/PDF) per unit and year via ASP.NET report viewer; no bulk file on https://gateway.ifionline.org/public/download.aspx
sources.institutions_covered: all state universities and colleges filing Form 100R (per Gateway: state government, state universities, state boards and commissions, local units)
sources.update_frequency: annual (100R filed each January for prior calendar year)
sources.terms: User must agree per IC 5-14-3-3(f) that names/addresses obtained will not be used for commercial or political purposes
sources.blocker: No bulk download; per-unit report export via ASP.NET form after accepting a non-commercial-use agreement.
sources.notes: Official statewide source covering every public institution. PFW library FAQ confirms Purdue is listed and the export icon gives CSV/Excel. Indiana Transparency Portal points to Gateway for higher-ed salaries. Did not run the report builder. Non-commercial-use clause may restrict how loaded data can be used.

sources.institutions_covered: none of the universities (they are not paid through the State Comptroller)
sources.notes: Recorded to show it excludes higher ed; portal itself redirects users to Gateway for higher education salaries.

sources.blocker: Third-party search only; derived from Gateway 100R data.

gaps: No bulk file; Gateway requires per-unit exports with a non-commercial-use agreement. No university-published salary lists found for IU, Purdue, Ball State, ISU, USI, Vincennes, or Ivy Tech. 100R gives total compensation only, not base vs other pay.
notes: Rated Gateway B (not A) because exports require the report-builder form and a terms acceptance; it is otherwise the single most complete source across my six states. Assumed Ivy Tech and Vincennes file 100R as state educational institutions (not verified).
